title: EKS Base Schema - Definitions
description: Pipeline configuration definitions. Document metadata definitions moved to eks_doc_base_schema.json (T1.34). discipline_code consolidated into discipline_entry_def.properties.code (removed as standalone def per U079). document_relationship_trigger_map stripped to shape-only (v1.4.0) â€” actual entries moved to config files (U086). revision_id moved to doc schema set (v1.5.0) â€” U087. v1.6.0: added required_folder_setup_def, required_file_setup_def, environment_setup_def, validation_options_def (T1.67). v1.7.0: replaced flat-array project_setup defs with DCC-aligned object definitions: folder_entry_def, root_file_entry_def, schema_file_entry_def, discovery_rule_def, environment_entry_def, dependency_config_def, validation_rule_entry_def, project_metadata_def (T1.85). v1.8.0: added system_parameters_def for T1.97/I088 SSOT runtime behavior settings. v1.9.0: added workflow_file_entry_def and tool_file_entry_def for T1.98.6/I090 (DCC project_config parity). v1.10.0: added export_default to system_parameters_def for T1.113/I234 schema-driven CLI --export default. v1.11.0: added telemetry_verbose to system_parameters_def for T1.120/I237 schema-driven TelemetryHeartbeat verbosity. v1.12.0: added 11 project definition definitions for I265 T1.190. v1.13.0: aligned project_definition_entry_def with appendix_l L.6.1 â€” added project_lifecycle_def, engineering_standards_def, runtime_profiles_def; removed pipeline_config_def and integration_config_def (deployment details moved to environment config per L.6.3); renamed security_config to security_profile; added 6 inline profile ref fields (parsing_profile, chunking_profile, embedding_profile, metadata_policy, prompt_profile, validation_profile) for I265 T1.198. v1.15.0: removed project_rules_def and project_definition_entry_def.compatibility (legacy_project_rules flag) for I265 T1.196 — eks_project_rules_config.json retired; fragment_required_fields now lives per-project in eks_project_definition_config.json. v1.16.0 (I281 T1.223): added generic processing_profile_registry_def container (profile_id, profile_type enum of 11, version, capabilities, constraints) shared by all processing profile types; added per-type defs — extraction_profile_def (superset of the removed doc-base parsing_profile_def: profile_id/parser_class/description/supported_extensions/supported_document_profiles/requires_ocr/extraction_methods + profile_type/version/capabilities/constraints), validation_profile_def (validation_layers), and shape-only stubs chunking_profile_def, retrieval_profile_def, indexing_profile_def, ai_reasoning_profile_def, graph_mapping_profile_def (recommended fields), embedding_profile_def, asset_profile_def, ontology_profile_def, prompt_profile_def. Values live in eks_processing_config.json (SSOT §9/§16); base holds shape only.

log_dir.description: Log directory relative to eks_root (T1.83 follow-up)

eks_root.description: EKS package root relative to project root (T1.83)

system_parameters_def.description: Runtime behavior settings for loaders, validators, servers, and registry retry behavior (T1.97/I088). Updated v1.10.0: added export_default for schema-driven CLI --export default (T1.113/I234). v1.11.0: added telemetry_verbose for schema-driven TelemetryHeartbeat verbosity (T1.120/I237).

export_default.description: Default export format for CLI --export flag (I234). Schema-driven SSOT â€” CLI reads at runtime.

telemetry_verbose.description: Emit milestone checkpoints (25/50/75/100%) to console during Phase B (I237). Schema-driven SSOT â€” PipelineOrchestrator reads at init.

document_relationship_trigger_map.description: Shape definition: maps document metadata field names to ontology relationship types. Actual entries defined per-schema-set in config files (eks_asset_config.json, eks_doc_config.json).

name.description: Relative path of the folder from project root

auto_created.description: Whether this folder is auto-created on first run

required.description: Whether this schema file is mandatory

workflow_file_entry_def.description: Workflow/pipeline file entry with metadata (DCC-aligned â€” project_config.json#/workflow_files, T1.98.6/I090)

filename.description: Workflow filename relative to project root

required.description: Whether this workflow file is mandatory

tool_file_entry_def.description: Tool/utility file entry with metadata (DCC-aligned â€” project_config.json#/tool_files, T1.98.6/I090)

filename.description: Tool filename relative to project root

required.description: Whether this tool file is mandatory

location.description: Where the environment file is located

setup_commands.description: Commands to set up the environment

optional.description: Whether this engine dependency is optional

project_identity_def.description: Project identity metadata (I265 T1.190/T1.198). Defines core project identification and classification fields used across the EKS pipeline.

contractor.description: EPC contractor or main contractor name

engineering_convention_def.description: Engineering conventions and standards applied to the project (I265 T1.190). Each field references a standard or scheme the project follows.

allowed_disciplines.description: List of discipline codes permitted for this project (migrated from project_rules_def)

document_profile_selection_def.description: Document processing profile references (I265 T1.190). Each field is a profile name resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver against reusable config libraries.

asset_profile_ref_def.description: Asset processing profile reference (I265 T1.190). Resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver against reusable asset config libraries.

profile.description: Asset processing profile name (e.g. process, instrument, electrical)

ontology_profile_ref_def.description: Ontology profile reference (I265 T1.190). Resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver against reusable ontology config.

retrieval_profile_ref_def.description: Retrieval and RAG profile reference (I265 T1.190). Resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver against reusable retrieval config.

security_config_def.description: Project security and access configuration (I265 T1.190/T1.198). Defines document classification and access policies for this project.

project_lifecycle_def.description: Project lifecycle and execution stage information (I265 T1.198). Provides contextual metadata influencing document processing and retrieval.

project_phase.description: Current project phase (e.g. FEED, Detailed Design, Construction)

execution_stage.description: Execution stage within the phase (e.g. IFC, IFD, AFC)

baseline_revision.description: Baseline revision identifier for the project

issue_status.description: Current issue status (e.g. issued, working, superseded)

document_status.description: Default document status for the project

engineering_standards_def.description: Engineering design standards adopted by the project (I265 T1.198). Keyed by discipline, value is the applicable standard code.

additionalProperties.description: Standard code for this discipline (e.g. ASME B31.3, IEC 61511)

runtime_profiles_def.description: Runtime service profile references (I265 T1.198). Deployment-specific infrastructure selected by profile name. Resolved against environment configuration by ProjectDefinitionResolver. No URIs or connection strings â€” profile references only.

storage.description: Storage service profile name (e.g. default_storage, s3_production)

vector_db.description: Vector database profile name (e.g. default_vector, production_qdrant)

graph_db.description: Graph database profile name (e.g. default_graph, neo4j_cluster)

project_definition_entry_def.description: Complete project definition entry (I265 T1.190/T1.198). Wraps all 18 configuration sections for a single project. Profile references are resolved by ProjectDefinitionResolver at runtime.

revision_validation.description: Revision format validation for this project. Specifies the regex pattern that valid revision strings must match (T1.191).

pattern.description: Regex pattern that valid revision strings must match.

metadata_policy.description: Metadata inheritance policy name (e.g. standard_inherit, minimal)

prompt_profile.description: AI prompt profile name (e.g. engineering_assistant, citation_focused)

validation_profile.description: Validation policy profile name (e.g. strict, relaxed)

fragment_required_fields.description: Per-fragment required field overrides (migrated from project_rules_def.fragment_required_fields). Key = fragment name, value = array of required property paths.

processing_profile_registry_def.description: Generic processing profile registry container (I281 T1.223). Shared by ALL processing profile types — each profile declares a profile_type from the 11-member enum and carries version/capabilities/constraints so it interoperates with other profile types. Per-type shapes are defined in extraction_profile_def / validation_profile_def / chunking_profile_def / retrieval_profile_def / indexing_profile_def / ai_reasoning_profile_def / graph_mapping_profile_def / embedding_profile_def / asset_profile_def / ontology_profile_def / prompt_profile_def. Actual profile VALUES live in eks_processing_config.json (SSOT §9/§16) — this is shape only.

profile_id.description: Unique processing profile identifier (referenced by Project Definition profile refs and config sections)

profile_type.description: Processing profile type (I281 Q3 — all 11 registry keys; each is a separate config section keyed {type}_profiles)

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities of this profile — consumed by the generic ProjectDefinitionResolver capability evaluator (no central compatibility matrix, L.13.6 V2).

constraints.description: Usage constraints on this profile (e.g. document classes, format categories).

extraction_profile_def.description: Named extraction (parsing) profile with declared capabilities (I281 T1.223 — superset of the removed doc-base parsing_profile_def, T1.195 V2). Capabilities are properties of the profile itself — ProjectDefinitionResolver extracts them during resolution and a single generic evaluator checks compatibility. No central matrix and no hardcoded pairs.

profile_id.description: Unique extraction profile identifier (referenced by Project Definition parsing_profile / document_profile.parser)

supported_extensions.description: Source file extensions this parser can process

supported_document_profiles.description: Document filename profiles (from doc config filename_profiles keys) this parser supports

requires_ocr.description: True when this parser needs an OCR profile (scanned input). Compared against Project Definition document_profile.ocr.

extraction_methods.description: Metadata extraction methods this parser supports (e.g. parser_metadata, cover_page_element)

capabilities.description: Declared extraction capabilities (e.g. layout_analysis, table_detection, symbol_detection).

validation_profile_def.description: Validation profile (I281 T1.223). Container for the multi-layer document validation rules per Appendix B B2.1 §4 — metadata/structure/business/engineering/graph/quality. The I284 column scoring_tier / applies_to_concepts mechanism is the column-value validation LAYER within this container (Q4) — complementary, not merged.

validation_layers.description: Per-layer validation rule sets per Appendix B B2.1 §4 Validation Profile.

chunking_profile_def.description: Chunking profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 2). Per Appendix B B2.1 §4 Chunking Profile.

retrieval_profile_def.description: Retrieval and RAG profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 2). Per Appendix B B2.1 §4 Retrieval Profile.

indexing_profile_def.description: Indexing profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3). Per Appendix B B2.1 §4 Indexing Profile (optional).

ai_reasoning_profile_def.description: AI Reasoning profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3). Per Appendix B B2.1 §4 AI Reasoning Profile.

graph_mapping_profile_def.description: Graph Mapping profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3; recommended fields per Q6, details evaluated later). Per Appendix B B2.1 §4 Graph Mapping Profile (optional, future).

entity_mapping.description: Mapping of source entities to graph nodes (recommended — details evaluated in future phase).

relationship_mapping.description: Mapping of source relationships to graph edges (recommended — details evaluated in future phase).

tag_type_mapping.description: Mapping of tag types to graph labels (recommended).

document_type_mapping.description: Mapping of document types to graph node categories (recommended).

embedding_profile_def.description: Embedding profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 2/3). Defines embedding model and vectorisation behaviour.

asset_profile_def.description: Asset processing profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3). Defines asset extraction behaviour per Appendix A fragment composition.

ontology_profile_def.description: Ontology profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3). Defines ontology mapping behaviour.

prompt_profile_def.description: AI prompt profile (I281 T1.223 — shape-only stub, Phase 3). Defines prompt construction behaviour for retrieval/RAG.

project_definition_registry_def.description: Project definition registry (I265 T1.190). Maps project codes to their Project Definition entries.
